Functional index Functional index.reasoning: This column lists the variable names (functional indices) being defined in the data dictionary.

Fire condition Estimate.reasoning: This column holds the numerical estimate (the measured value) for the functional index.

Fire condition Std. Error.reasoning: This column provides the standard error, which is a statistical measure of the measurement.

Fire condition P.reasoning: This column provides the P-value, which is a statistical result of the measurement.
